items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: So I'm a big guy, I saw him, Bernard, he told me, he said, listen, he said, you want to join my band?

ctx.x: That was some kid that wasn't as experienced.

So, well, they kept sending me in their place. And I just kept practicing. And every time playing a number, I remember the key it was in. And I practiced hard for the next time. They'd send me an horn like that. So I got to play most of the numbers that they would play. So I'm a big guy, I saw him, Bernard, he told me, he said, listen, he said, you want to join my band? He said, if them fellas can send you in their place and you can make out on them jobs, he said, well, you can be in the band regular. I said,…

Well, by the way, in regard to your teeth, did it ever wear your teeth at all through your lip? I guess it didn't. No. You never noticed any wear on your teeth then at all? Mm-mm. You still have your original teeth. I'm not trying to get personal or anything, but some people do play, George Lewis plays with false teeth in the helmet. Yeah. I think he said he's worn out one set of false teeth by just biting onto it. Yeah? I thought he'd bite them up, but I wasn't sure about it.
